offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm, catastrophic brain injury to partner
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to Mr. Cody to appeal his sentence, but I would otherwise dismiss the appeal from sentence and sustain the judgment of the learned sentencing judge.
note: Sentence 18 months plus 2 years probation as described in para 1.

sentence_quote: Mr. McIntosh, for the second degree murder of J.G., you are sentenced to imprisonment for life.
note: Parole ineligibility 17 years on joint submission; already serving 12 years for attempted murder.

sentence_quote: The court imposed a conditional discharge on Mr. Wolf.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; conditional discharge stands; DNA order remitted for new hearing.

offence_note: Breach of probation by failing to pay restitution
sentence_quote: We would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal, and order that the appellant serve a period of probation of three years.
note: Trial judge's $3,600 fine revoked; restitution of $3,913 made a probation condition.

offence_note: Unauthorized possession and careless storage of shotgun, silencer, magazines
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted, but the sentence appeal is dismissed.
note: Request for conditional sentence refused; health issues noted but accommodated by corrections.

offence_note: Drug and firearm offences, loaded guns and drugs found
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to a total of nine years’ incarceration less 42 months of pre-trial custody.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; sentence appeal dismissed as moot condition did not arise.

offence_note: Two counts break and enter dwelling with intent to commit theft
sentence_quote: For the break and enter with intent, contrary to s. 348(1)(b) of the Criminal Code, to 36 months imprisonment on each charge, concurrent to each other for a total of 36 months
note: Joint recommendation; sentence consecutive to time currently serving.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking methamphetamine; simple possession of cocaine
sentence_quote: I sentence you to two years of imprisonment with respect to Count 1 and one day of imprisonment with respect to Count 2, to be served concurrently.
note: Joint submission; DNA order declined; recommendation for health services within corrections.

sentence_quote: I conclude that the appropriate sentence is therefore four years' imprisonment.
note: Two months pre-trial custody credited at double; firearms prohibition later corrected to 5 years.

offence_note: Conspiracy to traffic in heroin and cocaine, organization head
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal is granted and the appeal is dismissed.
note: Eight years concurrent on each count; one year already allowed for pre-trial custody.

offence_note: Robbery of gas station attendant with pretended firearm

note: Consecutive to sentence being served; totality applied; victim surcharge waived.
